fixed.explanation: resolveGlobBase replaces every path token, including host and port, with an opaque placeholder, so URL normalization (default ports, percent-encoding, punycode) never applies to the pattern. The fix leaves tokens that have no glob special characters (*, ?, {, }, backslash) unchanged, so URL resolution normalizes them. Tokens with special characters are still replaced, which keeps the question-mark handling.
